name: Adobe
title: Buy Idea: 6-Month Price Target $317
drivers: Q3 FY26 record revenue of $6.76B (+13% y/y), ~0.9% ahead of consensus; non-GAAP EPS $6.13 beat.
AI-first ending ARR above $650M (+150% y/y); Firefly ARR +40% sequentially — AI monetised inside existing workflows.
Monthly active users passed 1 billion; creative freemium MAU +70% y/y feeding the paid funnel.
Full-year guidance raised for the second consecutive quarter.
Topaz Labs acquisition (AI image/video enhancement) expected to close in Q4 FY26.
FTC/DOJ subscription case settled ($150M) — a multi-year regulatory overhang removed.
financial_health: TTM free cash flow ≈ $10.3B (≈40% FCF margin), funding an active buyback ($24.55B authorisation remaining).
Cash & short-term investments ≈ $5.64B vs ≈ $7.1B debt — minimal leverage.
performance: Shares fell ~45% peak-to-trough since 2024 on generative-AI disruption fears.
Trades at ~9–10x forward earnings vs ~25x Microsoft, 25–29x ServiceNow, 14x Salesforce.
competition: Point-solution creative tools: Figma and Canva compete for the lower and mid-end of the creative base.
Generative-AI-native tools (OpenAI, Google, startups) can substitute parts of the Creative Cloud workflow for casual users.
Salesforce and HubSpot compete in experience/marketing software; Microsoft can bundle creative and document AI into Microsoft 365.
management: Incoming CEO: Anil Chakravarthy (from 1 Dec 2026); Shantanu Narayen moves to Executive Chair after 18 years as CEO.
David Wadhwani (President, Creativity & Productivity) stepped down 27 Sep 2026; stays as senior advisor.
risks: Generative-AI disruption of the core creative and document franchises.
CEO transition and key-person / execution risk.
Freemium monetisation and pricing-power risk (ARPU pressure).
Competitive intensity from Canva, Figma, Microsoft and AI-native tools.
news_sentiment: Sell-side split after Q3: RBC Outperform $315; JPMorgan Buy $315 (from $340); UBS $255, BMO and Wells Fargo $270; Citi Neutral $250; Morgan Stanley Underweight $240; CLSA initiated Outperform $300.
Consensus is Hold with average targets of ~$268–$278 (TipRanks, Investing.com, StockAnalysis, Public.com, Sep 2026).
ownership: Heavy passive ownership (Vanguard, BlackRock, State Street, Geode) gives a stable shareholder base.
Active managers mixed: some adding (Goldman Sachs, BNY Mellon), others trimming.
bottom_line: Adobe combines double-digit growth, industry-leading profitability and a valuation well below its own history and peers. AI-ARR and free cash flow suggest the de-rating has gone further than fundamentals justify, though the CEO handover and freemium monetisation could keep the stock range-bound near term.
valuation: Method 1 — Forward P/E (11.0x NTM non-GAAP EPS ≈ $26.20): $288.20
Method 3 — EV / NTM free cash flow multiple
valuation_bottom_line: We initiate with a BUY and a 6-month target of $317, triangulated across comparable multiples, DCF and a cash-flow multiple.
catalysts_to_watch: Q4 FY2026 results (expected December 2026) — the first quarter under the incoming CEO.
